items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I believe, uh, I don't know where Buddy played, uh, but I know they had different bands that used to play there. Whose Buddy? It's been so long, Buddy Petit, you know.

ctx.x: Because it was in the church, yeah. Yeah. And who would play in there?

Well, different bands, you know, like, I played with Rene there, kid Rene played there. We played there many times there, St. Catharines Hall. I remember now. And, uh, I believe, uh, I don't know where Buddy played, uh, but I know they had different bands that used to play there. Whose Buddy? It's been so long, Buddy Petit, you know. Oh, yeah. They had so many different bands. At that time, they had Kid, uh, Howard, and they had, uh, uh, Chris Kelly. Chris Kelly's band. And they had, uh, the, uh, Pelican band…
Mm-hmm. What, that, St. Catherine Hall, did they have, uh, dances there every night or just on the weekend?

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: Buddy Puthiel, Kid Punch, some of them.

ctx.x: I know he used to play with Avery and Tillman uptown when I heard him up by the park. Yeah.

At Tom Harris. Well, I guess that's about the same ones, you know. He had a band... That band was operating from Colton. That's the band that was way up in Colton. And he got that job out of Lincoln Beach. And that's a good bass. It's brand new. When I got it... He hadn't used it two years. You like new basses better than old basses? Oh, yeah. I can... I don't know. I like a new instrument. I used to have an old bass. It was called... Maple. It was a pure maple bass. And I used that bass and patched it up in…
I wonder about that. What bands did you play with when you'd be advertising?
